description: This file defines the PIMLeftMenuService class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing the left menu items in the Employee PIM (Personal Information Management) module. It handles retrieving, caching, and generating menu items based on user roles, permissions, and employee status.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuService
classes.description: Service class for managing the Employee Personal Information Management (PIM) left menu, including permissions, caching, and menu generation.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of EmployeeService.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves PIM menu items for a given employee, using cache if available.

methods.name: clearCachedMenu
methods.description: Clears cached menu items for an employee or all if no employee number provided.

methods.name: isPimAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the PIM menu is accessible for a given employee.

methods.name: generateMenuItems
methods.description: Generates menu items based on user permissions and employee status.

methods.name: isEmployeeWorkflowActionsAllowed
methods.description: Checks if workflow actions are permitted for an employee based on their state.

methods.name: getMenuFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves menu items from session cache for a specific employee.

methods.name: saveMenuInCache
methods.description: Stores menu items in session cache for an employee.

methods.name: getAvailableActions
methods.description: Returns the list of available actions, filtering out tax exemptions if disabled.

methods.name: isTaxMenuEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the tax menu is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getPreparedMenuItems
methods.description: Prepares and formats menu items for display, including URLs and active status.
